integrity: Exact analytic proof supplemented by 4358 finite exact assertions in check.py; independent review not performed.
scientific_limitations: Exact second-order law for unrestricted uniform set partitions, n>=3 and nonzero circular displacements. title: Arithmetic nullity of singleton–cyclic-adjacency cross-covariance in uniform set partitions
